pieces.Text: While maintaining psionic focus, you can deliver powers that feature a ranged touch attack as melee touch attack powers. You can use a ranged touch attack power that targets more than one creature, but you make only one melee touch attack to deliver
of these ranged touch effects; additional ranged touch attacks from that effect are wasted and have no effect. In addition, you can expend your psionic focus when you manifest a power to gain
temporary power points to augment that power.  You must use the power points to augment this power, or they are lost.
